text:
oliver: heads-up — after the control-plane upgrade in us-west-2 i'm seeing the cluster-autoscaler NOT spin up GPUs for the gpu-pool. a few prod pods pending with node selector for nvidia gpus.

maria: same in staging. pods stuck Pending, message 'no nodes available'. CA logs show 'no scale-up: no node group match' and some JSON parse warnings.

kev: CA log excerpt:
```
I0412 14:22:11 cluster_autoscaler.go:123] NoScaleUp: no template for node group 'gpu-p100-v2': unrecognized nodeGroup API version
I0412 14:22:11 event.go:45] Warning: Failed to parse nodegroup spec: unknown field "instanceType"
```

jin: this smells like an API shape change during the kube upgrade — nodepool CRD moved from v1beta1 to v1 and the field naming changed. CA's provider shim can't find the instance type, so it refuses to create nodes.

oliver: also noticed new nodes register with a different GPU label after the kubelet update: old label `nvidia.com/gpu.present=true` -> new label `kubernetes.io/gpu.present=true`. our CA filters and provisioning templates expect the old key.

maria: confirmed on a fresh node in canary: `kubectl get node -L nvidia.com/gpu.present,kubernetes.io/gpu.present` shows only the kubernetes.io label. that explains why scheduler+CA treat the node as non-GPU.

infra-bot: Deploy note: rolling cluster-autoscaler image build with tolerant nodegroup parser (rc) to canary at 22:00 UTC. :gear:

kev: short-term mitigation — i'm drafting a small mutating webhook that mirrors `kubernetes.io/gpu.present` -> `nvidia.com/gpu.present` on node create. PR: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/label-mirror/pull/7

anna: long-term we should either: update provisioning templates to use the new canonical label OR add a backward-compatible shim to CA. flag suggestion: `--node-group-api-shim=accept-v1beta1` so both shapes are supported.

jin: for Dedicated customers we need a backport plan. can we push the rc image and webhook as an emergency hotfix for affected clusters? impact window is small but affects GPU autoscaling and throughput/cost.

oliver: plan agreed: 1) deploy label-mirror webhook to prod canary 2) rollout CA rc with tolerant parser to canary nodes 3) monitor Pending GPU pods and metrics for +15m 4) schedule config bump for provisioning templates to match new labels and update docs. i'll own runbook.

maria: +1. please add rollback steps (webhook off, CA image revert). ping #incidents if anything touches control plane. :thumbsup:

srebot: Incident created: INC-2026-031 — autoscaler GPU provisioning regression after control-plane upgrade. runbook: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-031
